summary: Frontend-only test of /areas 3D map heat layer feature. Verified heat controls (OFF default active), DENSITY and LISTING VALUE toggle the legend on, OFF hides it. Source note always visible. Regression: 3 markers render, popup opens with /properties/<slug> link (/properties/prototype-chelsea-residence), and Chelsea/Kensington/Fulham cards present. Zero console errors across all interactions.
critical_code_review_comments: PropertyMap useEffect dependency array omits heatVisible/heatPoints from init effect intentionally (controller applies via separate effects) — correct. However, since map re-inits on `points` change, this is fine.
The heatmap uses paint 'heatmap-opacity' curve that fades at zoom>=14 (0.9->0.35); at default areas view zoom this is acceptable but subtle. Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AreasMapPanel heat feature works end-to-end. Default is OFF; DENSITY/PRICE both toggle 'foxy-heat' layer visibility and setHeatData via controller effects. Legend appears when mode!='off'. Source note always rendered. 3 markers wired with popup links to /properties/<slug>. No global map instance is exposed so layer visibility asserted indirectly via active button style + legend visibility; zero console errors confirmed.
